meaning: to ride a horse; in Taiwan Hakka also used loosely for riding astride a vehicle

example.english: He/she is learning to ride a horse.

note: The verb 騎 (kî) is the general word for riding anything you straddle, so it also appears in 騎單車 (kî tân-chhâ), though 單車 is already in your vocabulary. Horses were once a key means of transport in rural areas.
